units.source_text: 简直无法想像我不停歇地奔跑了多长的路程。

en.t: I could hardly imagine how far I had run without stopping.

units.source_text: 我也不记得都经过什么地方了。

en.t: I no longer remembered what places I had passed through.

units.source_text: 恐怕是从拱北楼的一侧，出北后门，经过明王殿旁，

en.t: Most likely, I had gone from one side of the Gongbei Tower, out through the north rear gate, and past the Myoo Hall,

units.source_text: 跑步登上了矮竹和杜鹃丛中的山路，

en.t: running up the mountain path through thickets of low bamboo and azaleas,

units.source_text: 来到了左大文字山的山顶上。

en.t: until I reached the summit of Mount Hidari Daimonji.
